families.checker_evidence: LayerChecker/ExternalDependencyChecker/AllowOnlyChecker scan only the changed project's own layer's own outgoing references; no other project's types are enumerated.
CycleChecker builds one shared inter-layer edge graph across every layer named by the contract and runs global cycle detection once over it; the dependents closure is not a safe bound.
PublicApiSurfaceChecker scopes to assemblies explicitly co-listed in one contract's assemblies field, a membership relationship not modeled by the project-reference graph.
Coverage checks classify each project/namespace independently from only that item's own namespaces, but current execution re-scans the whole solution and aggregates into one findings list per run.
